title: Denying P2 needs a physical account of how history acts

statements.text: A theory that denies local-state sufficiency conflicts with the local state-based framework of modern physics. A genuine departure must explain how historical information is carried, how it affects the system, and how locality, conservation laws and well-posed evolution are preserved. An omitted present variable is no departure: enlarging the state restores sufficiency.
